questions.question:
Which of the two numbers (Not digits) should be interchanged in the below equation to make it mathematically correct?

42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

Given:

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

(1) 7 and 9

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**42 ÷ 3**__ × 6 + 7 - 9

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**14 × 6**__ + 7 - 9

⇒ 84 + 7 - 9

⇒ 91 - 9 = 82

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) 3 and 7

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**42 ÷ 7**__ × 6 + 9 - 3

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**6 × 6**__ + 9 - 3

⇒ 36 + 9 - 3

⇒ 45 - 3 = 42

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(3) 6 and 7

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

After changing the signs:

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 7 + 9 - 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 14 × 7 + 9 - 6

⇒ 98 + 9 - 6

⇒ 107 - 6 = 101

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) 3 and 6

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 × 6 + 9 - 7 = 23

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**42 ÷ 6**__ × 3 + 9 - 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**7 × 3**__ + 9 - 7

⇒ 21 + 9 - 7

⇒ 30 - 7 = **23**

⇒ '42 ÷ 6 × 3 + 9 - 7 = 23'

Here, the equation is** satisfied.**

Hence, the correct answer is "**3 and 6**".

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All tops are bottoms.

All pullovers are bottoms.

All bottoms are pants.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pullovers are pants.

II. All pants are tops.

III. Some pants are pullovers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram from the given statement is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d376ac023287592d9a4967c45f483d9c9299aa64654db1d5754d7e91ae93ef9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pullovers are pants. → **F****ollows** (All pullovers are bottoms, and all bottoms are pants, which means all pullovers are pants is definitely true)

II. All pants are tops. → **Not follows** (All tops are bottoms, and all bottoms are pants, which means some pants are tops can be possible but not definitely true)

III. Some pants are pullovers. → **F****ollows** (All pullovers are bottoms, and all bottoms are pants, which means some pants are pullovers is definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusions I and III follow**".

questions.question:
If ‘A’ means ‘subtraction’, ‘B’ means ‘division’, ‘C’ means ‘multiplication’, and ‘D‘ means ‘addition’, then what will be the value of following expression?

28 A 80 B 16 C 5 D 21
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

As per the given data:

 
 

 **Symbol**
 **Means**
 
 

 A
 Subtraction (-)
 
 

 B
 Division (÷)
 
 

 C
 Multiplication (×)
 
 

 D
 Addition (+)
 
 

**Given:**

28 A 80 B 16 C 5 D 21

After putting the signs:

⇒ 28 - __**80 **____**÷16 **__× 5 + 21

⇒ 28 - __**5 × 5 **__+ 21

⇒ 28 - 25 + 21

⇒ 49 - 25 = 24

Hence, the correct answer is "24".
